reply.text:
Mostly a preference call. Sleeves hold warmth around the joint and some lifters like the feel of them on heavy sets, but they don't replace good technique or a sound base of strength, so I wouldn't lean on them for anything beyond comfort. If you feel fine without them, skip them and see how your working sets go, or wear them only on your heavier work.

If the question comes from your knees bothering you, that is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I'll train around whatever they clear.
